limitations: Automated research visualization; radiologist verification is required.
The August portal ZIP is truncated. Dynamic phases and T2 are available; DWI/ADC and the separate axial late series are not. Dynamic phase 4 is used for August morphology.
MRI signal is not absolute and is normalized to background liver.
ADC and low-signal fractions are exploratory proxies, not direct tumor-viability or necrosis measurements.
Dynamic enhancement depends on acquisition timing, contrast delivery and patient hemodynamics.
Tiny lesions with weak registered overlap are not forced into longitudinal matches.
